generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Built by Magna in Graz (late 2022-Mar 2024); Fisker filed for bankruptcy in Jun 2024. Two packs, which are variants inside this generation: Sport 80 kWh gross / 75 kWh usable LFP; One, Extreme and Ultra 113 kWh gross / 106.5 kWh usable NMC. DC listed at 175 kW for all trims (other sources differ), 7.4 kW AC (Wikipedia; other markets' figures not checked), CCS1 in North America. US deliveries from Jun 2023. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fisker_Ocean
